notes.title: 🎉Samurai Theme is Here, New Game Mode on the Way! 🎉
notes.content:
[h2]🔸 New Samurai Theme is Here! 🔸[/h2]

Our new theme brings the spirit of the samurai to the world of Feign! You can now purchase a total of 7 new samurai costumes and an exclusive new house for this theme, some available with cookies and others with Feign gold. Choose your favorite costume and show your style in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/40a135e183cc0f06e41fbd0c178905045cdfa0e2.jpg[/img]

[h2]🎨 New Game Mode on the Way! 🎨[/h2]

We've started working on an exciting new game mode! In this mode, our characters will gather around a table, trying their best to draw the given prompts while attempting to find the traitor among them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/34d4b3aa6c7cd6b98fd4b691804486a6a0a71a87.gif[/img]

Get ready for fun-filled moments where your drawing skills and detective abilities will shine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/eb442bf5aadc33f67cf6520e96a001c55a4337b4.gif[/img]

Will you be able to uncover the traitor?

[u]🚧 Note: The visuals shared for the new game mode are still under development and are not final. 🚧[/u]

Stay tuned as we continue bringing you exciting updates! 🎮✨

notes.title: Reporting System is Live
notes.content:
Hello Feign Players! 🎃🍂🎉

We're here with an exciting new update bringing all the colors and features of autumn right to you. Here are the new additions and improvements we've prepared for you:

[h1]Highlighted Features:[/h1]

[b]Reporting System:[/b] The long-awaited reporting system is now live to help maintain the health of our community! You can now easily report inappropriate behaviors like offensive language, cheating, griefing,  teaming , or offensive player names, helping to create a fairer gaming environment.

[b]Autumn Costumes:[/b]
We've brought the spirit of the season into the game! Customize your character and express your style with brand new autumn-themed colorful costumes. 🍁🎭
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/9e5112a40af26b7a1d55ca312b70abf01ca2136f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/4e027307a5a66995840c6dbb9fc960e21305824a.png[/img][/url]
[b]Join Lobbies with a Code:[/b]
We've made creating private games with friends more secure and convenient! With the new code-based lobby system, you can easily join private rooms, connect from both mobile and PC, and get together quickly. 🔒
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/348ae4faa1b1a7a677ad64d6087fe212156a1479.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/4898d80d12ea92e6763c57710dc160bb7d901bcd.png[/img][/url]
[b]Leave the Game with Your Bag:[/b]
Players who leave the game are now sent off with their bags. This small but impactful detail adds a fun touch to the game atmosphere. 🎒
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/b1bc10c4495f2ebd0a65d5d689a9c87b91f687fa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/36d003178588e8f1b15f522cf2ed04b498545e39.png[/img][/url]
[b]Offline Notification System:[/b]
Stay updated with important developments easily thanks to the new notification system.

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]

The connection between lobby creation and joining has been improved, making transitions between different devices (PC and mobile) smoother.

In-game performance has been increased, and several bugs have been fixed. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/23687a357c39b8d728b9596a0b93637e0c9faf4a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/9bd9082efe03d4a641c9cdf0fd629415678c2239.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Major Costume Pack Update!
notes.content:
Hello Feign players! 🎉

We have exciting news for you: we've added brand-new costume packs to Feign! 🎁 You can now customize your characters with 4 different themes:

[list]
[*] [b]Cardboard Theme Pack[/b] 📦: Gain a fun look with creative cardboard designs.
[*] [b]Candy Theme Pack[/b] 🍭: Add color to the game with sweet designs.
[*] [b]Lava Theme Pack[/b] 🌋: Draw attention with fiery costumes.
[*] [b]Crystal Theme Pack[/b] 💎: Shine with mysterious and magical crystal costumes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/85ed6770a44e1f2e89c318d735bd1da66a82d831.png[/img]

[b]Along with this major update, we've also added the following improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*][b] In-Game Purchase System Added[/b] 🛒: You can now purchase costumes and other items directly from the market.
[*] [b]Market Updated[/b] 🛍️: Our market is richer with new character costumes.
[*] [b]Connection Infrastructure Updated[/b] 🔧: For a more stable gaming experience, we've upgraded our connection infrastructure to "socket.io" version 4.7.5.
[*] [b]Player Disconnect Animation[/b] 🏃‍♂️: Players who disconnect now run away from the village instead of dying in front of the door, making it easier to understand the situation.
[*] [b]Visual Improvements [/b]🎨: Fixed minor visual glitches in the outlines of characters and houses.
[*][b] Translation Updates[/b] 🌐: We updated the game translations from Localizer for a smoother experience.
[/list]

Thank you for your support, and have fun playing! 🎮

notes.title: Home Costumes Here!
notes.content:
You can now dress up your homes in Feign with [b]different costumes[/b]! Go to the market now and buy home costumes to change the appearance of your homes in the game. 🏘️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/644788835e71aed97cce1d583390d59923826753.png[/img]

With this [b]major update[/b], we've established the [b]infrastructure[/b] to let you customize home costumes in Feign. This means we can share new home costumes that allow you to change the village theme to your [b]own style[/b].

Currently, [b]5 new home costumes[/b] have been added to the game, with many more [b]on the way[/b] 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/c24c8be388fdbbe712be1a0e577550dd5f75871d.png[/img]

Of course, this major update also includes other changes. Here are the details:
[list]
[*] [b]Character Role Visuals:[/b] The visuals for the Trapper's trap, the Bomber's detonation box, etc., have been updated to match the general visuals better.
[*] Google Play Store visuals and [b]trailer[/b] have been updated.
[*] [b]Market System:[/b] Updated to support multiple item types.
[*] [b]Character Materials:[/b] All characters now use the same material.
[*] [b]Spine2D:[/b] Customized to use less RAM.
[*] [b]Visual Materials:[/b] Materials for characters, trees, houses, and backgrounds have been optimized to reduce draw calls.
[*] [b]Server Code Improvements:[/b] DatabaseManager and LogManager codes have been improved.
[*] [b]GameApi Structure:[/b] Systems like MarketApi, RewardApi, and ReportApi have been restructured into GameApi for better server and client organization.
[*] [b]Visual Cleanup:[/b] Unused visuals have been removed from the project.
[*] [b]UI Visuals:[/b] UI visuals have been resized for better screen fit and packed into a single atlas for fewer draw calls and lower RAM usage.
[*][b] Scene Transitions:[/b] For devices with low RAM, scene transitions have been optimized first to remove all objects from the current scene and clear them from RAM with Resources before loading the new scene.
[/list]

notes.title: New houses for our little Fei's is here
notes.content:
We renovated our houses in the town of Feign. While doing this, we overhauled the drawing of the entire village.
While creating this new theme, we took care to make a theme with darker colors, taking into account the lowering brightness demands of our players.
With this new house update, we have now paved the way for bringing house costumes to the game, and soon we will be able to customize our own houses, just like we dress our fei characters.

In addition to this main improvement, we also made a few minor improvements. We list them below:

[list]
[*] The time counter visual in the game has been improved. Yes, this image has been on our minds for a long time and it was time to get it out of the way :)
[*] How to play part has been improved. You can now practice entering the game with your character in the "how to play" section.
[*] Police Fei sound bug has been fixed. If the person the police visited did not leave the house, the police would stop waiting early and return. However, during this period, the blocking sound continued to be heard. We also fixed this error.
[/list]

notes.title: Character Balance and New Outfits
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 

The new character balance is added to the game. With this update, our 6th major step is finished in our update plan. We also added a new set of costumes to the market.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/56d3a4a23a1a38169f510874f5d5c12a24217955.png[/img]

Below you can see all the changes done with this update :

[h3]Sorcerer: [/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/cd966c35ebc8263ec84f154558daff5819109b5b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/b6937979dde05b02b6eca44ccddc7f13144612d4.png[/img][/url]
Analysing the game data we realized that winning with the sorcerer was too hard. Therefore we added a boost to them where they can protect themselves from all attacks during nighttime :) The only exception to this rule is the haunter. So now the only way to have a sorcerer lose the game is to vote it out during the daytime or have a haunter visit it.

[h3]Haunter:[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/bbfa51db5243bc97c84beb608f7089c17ca6afb4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/9747c6f97e88a229484dc3c4f9ddd9c135359a02.png[/img][/url]
In most of the games, it was too easy for players to vote the Haunter out. So we wanted to make it a little bit harder to vote for haunter. When a haunter is voted out of the town, then the player that it kills loses the game no matter what. So be careful now while voting out a haunter because its candle might be next to your house.

[h3]Insane: [/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/a545eda1fc07c8bdac618a00455defc4056d7b39.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/b5298c8f163b1335978696062e8395a2a53b7f26.png[/img][/url]
If you add at least one random role while creating the game, the insane can now disguise itself as any role that can be insane. Previously, it could only be disguised as a role that was already in the game. We hear your complaints on this issue and fix it with this update.

Market:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/255c663d88c8d5f1c3933f39177cf1e8f6d68731.png[/img]
There are also new costumes added to the market now. 
As usual, we take some of the old costumes out of the market to make room for the new ones. Have you collected enough cookies to get what you want?

notes.title: Feign is 1 year old !
notes.content:
This is it, today we finished our first year of Feign since our early access launch on Steam. Hundreds of thousands thanks to everyone who enjoys Feign.

If you remember, we had a big 4-stage update plan for Feign that we shared with you, and today we are proud to say as we completed all of those. Now today we are sharing a new set of major update goals for the upcoming months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/aa4803ba42daa66d6a9c72552eb00b3a423aa97d.png[/img]

In the first major update, we brought global chat and auto-translation to the game. The aim here was to remove the language barrier a bit and allow players from all over the world to experience the game together.

We balanced the characters in the second major update. Some characters were very strong, others were very weak.

In the third major update, we added 3 new characters to the game. Tracker, Sorcerer, and Haunter characters. 

In the fourth major update, we launched Feign Mobile for android devices.

[b]Now going forward our aim with major updates is as follows.
[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]5.[/b] We will have the skin system released to the game. This will allow us to have all the different costumes for our cute characters :)

[*] [b]6.[/b] With the arrival of our new characters we realized that there is a need for a new character balance for an improved game experience. In this step, we will carefully do this. Also, there is a need for a colorblind mode for accessibility to our game. We will also add this new feature to the game in this step.

[*] [b]7.[/b] When you die in Feign, it becomes hard to follow what is happening in the game. We will add a new dead vision to the game where whenever you die you can use this role to see exactly what one of the alive players is seeing during that night. We are sure this will be a lot of fun :)

[*] [b]8.[/b] In this 8th step we are planning to make major UI improvements for our lobby creation, end game, and many more screens.
[/list]

---------------------------------------

[b]Some final words of what we added today:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Now you can create a game with a much longer daytime to discuss more if you want. An extensive player base was wanting to have more daytime, so we added [b]600seconds[/b] and[b] 1200seconds[/b] options for the daytime game. We are discussing adding even longer options but this is to be decided later.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/59e9a51c5ca420d3af73c73c28d684285520ec0c.png[/img]

[list]
[*] We were getting complaints that some of our players were using some very disturbing lobby names, so as a temporary solution, we decided to lock lobby names. So for now you can not edit your lobby name and it is given by default as [b]<<your name>>'s Lobby.[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/893b5ca6a1eecf2f3a2725deba50d34f4bc64dae.png[/img]

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.3.3
notes.content:
As you all know we enabled Cross-Play of Feign with Android Devices almost 2 weeks ago. So many new players have joined our PC players in the game, way above our expectations. You can see this situation in the game due to the intensity of the global lobbies.  

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/8e41946049548953efc878207e8f8c5d085098c5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/bda5dfb3e12fe48958b23e88fd1ff99ea089f35f.png[/img][/url]

Although all this new player mass makes us very happy, we were aware that there were also some players who were experiencing problems such as slowdown in the game, late starts or not being able to start the games due to this density and new bugs that come with Feign mobile. 

We worked hard and solved all these problems! However, let us remind you that you can always report any problem you encounter with our bug report tool (the little red bug button in the upper right corner of the game 🙂). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/dffdc4c5080820493071cbfbc4253902e7bd5534.png[/img]

Here is the list of items that are solved or added :

[list]
[*] A bug is solved that prevented some lobbies to start.
[*] A bug is solved that caused some players to drop from the game.
[*] Version control added for overall game experience.
[*] Automatic decks are updated
[*] Fixed a bug preventing Sorcerer to select an innocent investigator when using its role.
[*] Speak visualization button added for mobile players, so they can also show you in game that they are talking if you are in a discord channel together.
[*] In game notification system added for better communication with players. There are 3 types of notifications with a white or yellow or red label as shown below:
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/1027379494b11e63d206920617c966724b7f67d3.png[/img]

notes.title: New Supported Language: Indonesian
notes.content:
With this new update, a brand new language is added to the game: Indonesian 

We also made some changes and fixed some bugs along this update. 
[list]
[*] Lookout can now see the Tracker and insane Tracker.
[*] When an insane role was blamed it appeared as a red insane. This major bug is also fixed for good.
[*] Some of our players were getting stuck on the loading screen for no reason from time to time. We investigated and fixed this issue.
[*] We also added a new error message when there is a steam initialization error is detected, explaining what you should do step by step.
[*] The bug report tool is upgraded. Now you can upload your bugs twice as fast as before.
[*] We were getting complaints about players who were sending very long messages in chat. In-game chat messages are now limited to 500 characters.
[/list]

If you want to help us with improving our translation of currently supported languages or add new languages to the game, you can always do that through this link very quickly even via just voting: https://www.localizor.com/feign

notes.title: Our new Character Pack is here ! Haunter, Tracker, and Sorcerer!
notes.content:
3 New Characters are added to the game with this major update v.0.3.0 One of them is an innocent role which also imposters can have. Two others are neutral roles that can change the course of gameplay. 
[previewyoutube=C4BkS9Qqudo;full][/previewyoutube]
Let's check them one by one in detail:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/4addb2d83750da693eba5a9ab0a01eaf6c5459e5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/6acdce41fb91e1adbbecd5975102cfc6d5d0da99.png[/img][/url]
[h3] Haunter
[/h3]
[list]
[*] He puts a candle in the house of a person he wants at night.
[*] If he can get kicked out of the village in the morning, he will come to the house where he put a candle the next night, haunting him.
[*] Even the doctor can't save the attacked person. Survivors' shields can not defend against this attack either.
[*] The condition for the Haunter to win is to get himself kicked out of the village and kill the person he puts a candle in at night.
[*] One last extra tip is that when you see the traitors killed the player you put the candle in, you must do your best not to be kicked out of the village that round because if you do, you will lose the game since you will not be able to kill your target in the night.
[/list] -----------------------------------------------------
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/aa20dfafa0f15f4bb3fd86905c0031e0199f894d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/766ca0a54bbf96226aeb13c7179dc5271c359adf.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Tracker[/h3]
[list]
[*] He pours paint in front of the house of the player he chose at night.
[*] In the morning, if the player who spilled paint in front of his house left his house, you can understand where he went by looking at his footprints.
[*] Of course, roles that can masterfully assassinate like serial killers do not fall into this trap of the tracker.
[/list] -----------------------------------------------------
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/8a7f92aad62f476065d5282d6789f9da23676cd5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/3ec783e18aa3f171e79e6e3cbb4ef5ee165927c2.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Sorcerer[/h3]
[list]
[*] At night, the sorcerer can cast a spell on any player he wants by casting a spell with his book.
[*] As the sorcerer does his attack without leaving his house, neither the trapper, the police nor the scout will be able to stop the sorcerer while he performs his lightning strike.
[*] As if that's not enough... even the doctor can't save the player he struck by lightning.
[*] The sorcerer is unstoppable and although he is an expert at not getting caught by the villager, he has bigger problems to watch out for.
[*] The sorcerer must correctly ascertain the role of his chosen one in order to be able to attack. If he guesses the player's role correctly and casts a spell, he will kill the person.
[*] If he guesses the wrong role, he won't be able to cast the spell correctly and the 3rd lightning bolt will fall on the sorcerer himself, turning him into ashes.
[/list]

Both of the new neutral roles are designed to open a 3rd discussion mechanic door to the game. Even the possibility of a sorcerer being in the game opens up a new mechanic for the traitors. When they are forced to tell their role they can persuade the town to wait a little longer. Or a traitor who was caught lying might say that I deliberately said my role differently because there is a sorcerer in the game, otherwise, he could have killed me. Also, the role haunter makes both the innocents also the imposters think twice before kicking someone out of the town because they can be the ones haunted at night.

In addition, a new soundtrack has been added to the game with this major update.

notes.content:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/8c60053fd70336be5b400bd69aa93f4c365e04fe.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/a34492be231ee4e6daab0749460445bd0dd445b4.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/ba9e94f8bb5e98bf865501fb992302356b41c456.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/d9aaa9cb4ed356c0ea910ca9256979ae176e88d9.png[/img][/url]

[b]SERIAL KILLER:[/b] The role of the person killed by a serial killer will always appear as an unknown yellow question mark.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/124c23d1887c5bea40dad0ed859273fbeb9366a3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/76cb0e8376017bdd73901fa6fb9dacd697e51480.png[/img][/url]

[b]BOMBER:[/b] The bomber will not be able to be blocked by the police when he tries to blow up his bombs.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/590658c1890894ba1fe6a5c5dd94902defc026fb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/c059895431848055b61b15c8a0cdecb56fafd249.png[/img][/url]

[b]THIEF:[/b] When the thief steals the bomber role he steals also all of his bombs that he already placed in other houses. However, don't be afraid if there is also a bomb in your house. You will detonate all of your bombs except the one that is placed in your own house.
When the investigator role is stolen by the thief, it will also steal all of the information cards that the investigator already has.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/cc78b2a59819c030e25a2ffbf6debc452cd2760a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/c268c41203585a987bc091f3beaac0a3fa0f15b9.png[/img][/url]

[b]INSANE:[/b]
Insane infrastructure has been upgraded. Now if an insane doctor visits a player, he sees that the insane doctor arrives at the house. So now the doctor will not be able to understand that he is not insane when he is seen. 
The insane role can also think now that he is a snitch.
When a lookout saw a lot of people visiting a house, he immediately thought he was insane. Now the number of players that the insane lookout sees is reduced to solve this issue.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/a545eda1fc07c8bdac618a00455defc4056d7b39.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/b5298c8f163b1335978696062e8395a2a53b7f26.png[/img][/url]

If the provoker uses his role and if that person dies that night the provoker does not lose one of his provoking rights.

[b]TRAPPER: [/b]The location of the trap set by the trapper will always be in front of the door, so there will be no visual error of being trapped behind the house and missing that information in case you were not paying attention.

[h3]GENERAL:[/h3]
A special star is added next to the moderator's name so it is more visible now.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/c736a90eaf6987bdc9d60da7ece091de1bd0358c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/a4cd0eea87a3d4963b0432cf78f39296d1ab9891.png[/img][/url]
There is also a small icon added next to the player's his/her character in the game.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/868a5ccab5bc3450b55b8fe9614c24d15fe7f53a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/54412b5f36662d61cfacafd7153f8b1fcc484aa0.png[/img][/url]
Now dead players see both the insane role and the role that the insane players think he is.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/0d370e158c4269e95efb64b9bd160d2620957f8c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/1931850367a0a72a023c79c6d65235ab400447cf.png[/img][/url]
Dead players see also bombs that are already planted or if a person is blamed by the blamer.
Dead players can now also see how many rights the roles such as provoker, snitch, blamer, or survivor have left.
The information of the person joining the lobby is shared in the lobby chat. 
The character walking animation has been made smoother.
In terms of using the roles, the ranking is now randomized every turn, and the same roles, impostor or innocent, will have a different priority each turn. So for example, if 2 police try to block each other, every round the outcome can be different.

We also made some minor improvements and fixed a lot of bugs: 
Infinite sending error in bug reporting tool has been fixed 
Bug reporting tool not showing sent feedback has been fixed 
Fixed a bug where you could not cast votes in the next round if you tried to vote for a house during the animation.
Role usage infrastructure has been improved which solved minor bugs on role usage at night.
The connection infrastructure has been improved which solved the disconnection problem experienced by players with low processor power.
Fixed a bug that caused players leaving the game to be seen as a white role in the endgame panel.
Fixed the bug that caused insane or doctors to be seen sometimes as a red insane or red doctor role when they are blamed.

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.2.2
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 
As you know we recently introduced our community to the new game mode where you can play with anyone around the world even if you don't know their language with the help of the auto-translate chat feature. However, we realized that waiting for 12 people in the lobby might take a little bit too long sometimes :) So we reduced these game lobbies to start at 8 people. However in normal custom lobbies and private lobbies you can still play together with up to 12 people.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/7b22f67415c04eed611734cf93ded1e9517af265.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/090d6a871522daf99740e4759d7d10faf94de724.png[/img][/url]
So full list of bugs and fixes are listed below:
[list]
[*] The global lobby size has been reduced to 8 people.
[*] When players log in to global lobbies, the number of users required for the game to start automatically is reported in the chat.
[*] Fixed a bug where anyone could join private lobbies.
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes players could not load the lobby, preventing the game from starting.
[*] Fixed the single-player lobby issue that remained open despite all players exiting.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused players to be able to enter full rooms.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused users with 32-bit CPUs to be unable to launch the game.
[*] Updated game link infrastructure.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.2.0
notes.content:
In this major release, we added 2 new important features:[b] Quick Play[/b] and [b]Auto translate chat feature[/b]. This Quick Play game mode will put you in an official lobby where you will play with random players [b]around the world[/b] using only [b]in-game written chat[/b]. The full list of items fixed or updated in this major release are listed below:

[list]
[*] New Game mode: Quick Play
[*] Auto translate chat feature
[*] New and easily understandable UI for in-game chat
[*] The role order of Insane is improved. Now it is executed in the order of the role that the insane thinks he or she is. Previously because of this bug if the insane thinks he is a cop and sees that the doctor visits him before he performs his role he knew that he is insane for sure. Now his insane character will perform his role in the right order.
[*] Now Lookout role sees also insane when both visit the same house in the same round
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the whole town to wait on the person that just left or dropped from the game during game start. So no more waiting on a vote of a dropped player 🙂 
[*] Switched to IL2CPP scripting backend
[*] Security improvement on Bug Report Tool
[*] Solved a bug that caused the game to freeze during zoom in and out
[*] Language translation improvements are done as suggested by our community [url=https://www.localizor.com/feign]in Localizor[/url]
[*] Chat spam limitation applied
[*] Memory optimization such as background-image character animations & images and fonts 
[*] Fixed the bug that sometimes caused all entities (such as characters, rabbits, etc) to move backward in the game.
[*] Settings panel improved
[*] Imposter in how to play mini-game has been changed to a serial killer for easy understanding
[*] The Winter theme is removed
[*] Menu background images are updated
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/99a7965e3c2a9e07aa21247b9d41acd495fc2657.png[/img]

notes.title: Our new Game mode is here! ----- QUICK PLAY with Auto Translation Chat Feature
notes.content:
Do you want to play together with players around the world even if you don't know how to understand their language? Do you want to join an official game that you can join easily and play without the hustle of joining any voice channels?
Then you should try our brand new game mode for sure: [b]QUICK PLAY[/b]  with [u]Auto Translation Chat Feature (Beta) [/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/708e6d0238dc3f918e89245736aeb3f595c3b6ba.png[/img]

This game mode will put you in an official lobby where you will play with random players around the world using only in-game written chat. 

Don't worry you don't need any translator because this game mode also has an Auto Translation Chat Feature enabled. You will see the whole chat translated to your own language during the game no matter who wrote in which language. This feature is still in beta so please go tell us any improvement areas you can see about it. There might be some changes for the core of this feature along the way already.

[h3]QUICK PLAY[/h3]
It is also very easy to start playing in this new game mode. You go to the main menu and click on the [b]QUICK PLAY[/b] button. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/9dfe96b53b6abddc6b0a9fb7b2abe7bbede516d2.png[/img]

Then the game will put you in one of the [b]chat-only global lobbies[/b]. 
The game will start [b]automatically [/b]when there are [b]12 people[/b] in the lobby. In this new game mode, there is [b]no host of the lobby[/b] and for now, you will only play with roles that are set as default in the game lobby. 
[b]Auto Translation Chat Feature[/b] will be active in both the lobby chat window and also in-game chat window, so do not hesitate to [b]type in your own language[/b]. Everyone will see it translated in his/her own language.

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.1.8
notes.content:
This week we mainly focused on game mechanics and worked on several backend requirements for the mobile version of Feign. Here you can see the list of items fixed/updated related to the game mechanics.
[list]
[*] We have seen that spamming of some actions were affecting game stability so we limited these actions up to 6 times per second as a maximum (Role usage at night, voting and pressing space to show you are talking )
[*] [b]Snitch is nerfed[/b]. Now only the Snitch sees the actual role now of the snitched person. It is up to you to believe him or not.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223057/c14c0ff8a7c310efdc5ffb65775d6ca7a062f0f0.png[/img]
[*] Language font support is upgraded to solve unsupported fonts that were causing squares to appear for names of players and for messages in lobby chat.
[*] Voting system is updated. Now a person is kicked out of the town only if he/she receives majority of the votes. Also votes that were not being used until the timer runs out are counted as skip votes. Also in the event of a tie of votes no one is kicked out of the town. So a couple of voting examples are here to make it easier to understand: 
[**] Person A (3 Votes)  - Person B (4 Votes) - Skip (1 Vote) - #of alive and not voted people (4)  = No one is kicked out of the town
[**] Person A (3 Votes)  - Person B (4 Votes) - Skip (1 Vote) - #of alive and not voted people (2)  = Person B is kicked out of the town
[**] Person A (4 Votes)  - Person B (4 Votes) - Skip (1 Vote) - #of alive and not voted people (1)  = No one is kicked out of the town
[**] Person A (4 Votes)  - Person B (2 Votes) - Skip (1 Vote) - #of alive and not voted people (3)  = No one is kicked out of the town
[/list]
